# Native drag lookup invokes a closed window's retired source

## Context

An isolated packaged Fleet candidate (Institution `5622344`, Brain `e7ee18ee`, Engine `2d3e6fa8`) opens a second cockpit in the same App Worker and closes it during the native smoke journey. A subsequent primary-window position event throws:

```text
NativeLifecycle.ownerEntries: sources is undefined
  → VesselContainer.resolveNativeWindowDrag
  → DragTarget.getNativeWindowDrag
  → DragCoordinator.getNativeWindowDragSource
  → DragCoordinator.onWindowPositionChange
```

Neural Link inspection after the close finds the popup cockpit and its DragTarget still registered under the disconnected window id. Its NativeLifecycle reports `isDestroyed: true`; the primary cockpit's owner is live. Current window topology contains the primary only. This is candidate evidence, not an installed-fleet incident. The [Fleet delivery record](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/674#issuecomment-6165093863) owns the native context.

## The Problem

Native source lookup invokes every retained sort-zone resolver without first checking whether that source's physical window is still registered. An unrelated live window's geometry event can therefore call a disconnected projection whose native owner has already retired.

The separate missing-parent DOM insertion observation from the previous smoke remains unclassified; this ticket does not claim to repair it. Historical #18390 repairs source withdrawal when a DemoB is destroyed, and #19462 concerns legacy Dashboard return. Neither describes this live-window lookup boundary.

Design authority: an observed uncaught exception; `Window.onWindowDisconnect` removes the window from the live geometry registry, and the coordinator already reads that registry for physical popup/target geometry.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/manager/DragCoordinator.mjs#getNativeWindowDragSource` iterates registered zones and invokes `getNativeWindowDrag`.
- `src/manager/Window.mjs#onWindowDisconnect` unregisters physical-window geometry.
- `src/dashboard/dock/window/DragTarget.mjs#getNativeWindowDrag` delegates to the participation's resolver.
- Group-owned NativeLifecycle records and view lifetime are separate. Closing a window does not authorize deleting retained documents or ownership.

## The Fix

Bound native source lookup by the existing Window registry before invoking a zone's resolver. Preserve the live main-window resolver which can name a distinct physical popup. Do not catch and discard arbitrary resolver exceptions or recreate a retired Group.

Add red-first coverage in the existing `test/playwright/unit/manager/DragCoordinator.spec.mjs`, including disconnected-source exclusion and the live-source positive control. No new module or API is expected.

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DragCoordinator.getNativeWindowDragSource` | registered physical windows in `Neo.manager.Window` | invokes only resolvers whose source window is live; permits a live source to identify another live popup | no eligible resolver returns null | existing method JSDoc | disconnected callback is never invoked; live native drag still resolves |

Decision Record impact: none; restores physical-window eligibility without changing Group/document retention.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] After a registered source window disconnects, its retained resolver is not invoked by native drag lookup or a later live-window position event.
- [ ] A live main-window source can still identify its separate popup and participate in the existing native drag/drop path.
- [ ] Re-established live-window eligibility is observed from the registry, without a permanent tombstone or a second liveness cache.
- [ ] A regression arm fails on the current lookup and passes with the repair; focused native-drag tests remain green.
- [ ] A source/native candidate receipt separates this exception from the still-unclassified missing-parent delta observation.

## Post-Merge Validation

The actual Fleet update and operator verification remain on neomjs/neo-agent-institution#12. This source leaf does not close the runtime-continuity or installed-seat acceptance outcome.

## Out of Scope

Retiring semantic documents, changing NativeLifecycle ownership, global component cleanup, the missing-parent delta diagnosis, and any live Fleet installation or seat restart.

### Ownership-contract read for the bounded lookup repair

I recovered the cited #18314 history and checked the source at the candidate's Engine `2d3e6fa8` / Institution `5622344`.

**The accepted contract has two separate lifetimes.** [ADR 0029 §2.3](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2d3e6fa8ef2ac4f922ea2e536f1e57f1197076ab/learn/agentos/decisions/0029-docking-design.md#L349-L353) makes the Workspace facade own its composed Participation; [§2.8.2–3](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2d3e6fa8ef2ac4f922ea2e536f1e57f1197076ab/learn/agentos/decisions/0029-docking-design.md#L527-L543) separates terminal interaction cleanup from retained worker documents. A headless document is legitimate; it does not establish a live physical drag source.

The explicit cleanup path is already present: [Workspace.destroy](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2d3e6fa8ef2ac4f922ea2e536f1e57f1197076ab/src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs#L1585-L1601) retires Participation before withdrawing the native source; [Participation.destroy](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2d3e6fa8ef2ac4f922ea2e536f1e57f1197076ab/src/dashboard/dock/window/Participation.mjs#L798-L819) destroys its target; [DragTarget.destroy](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2d3e6fa8ef2ac4f922ea2e536f1e57f1197076ab/src/dashboard/dock/window/DragTarget.mjs#L475-L487) unregisters it. A Workspace becoming headless also retires its owned participation through `windowId = null` → `afterSetWindowId` → `syncParticipation`. An adopted collaborator remains its creator's responsibility.

The earlier #18314 guard was deliberately narrower: [unregisterSource](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2d3e6fa8ef2ac4f922ea2e536f1e57f1197076ab/src/manager/transaction/NativeLifecycle.mjs#L82-L90) allows **late view cleanup after Group destruction**. Its regression test says exactly that. It does not authorize ordinary `ownerEntries` reads through a destroyed owner, and adding an empty-map fallback there would erase that distinction. Historical anchor: memory `aea04d76-5215-4367-a591-2db1d74ec2d1`, session `d14f2413-4744-43e9-a6c1-191166d58fe9`.

**The candidate exercises a full-app close.** [harness/main.mjs:1619](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/blob/5622344ddf13f4ec8d839ca9707f04a9c7598c8e/harness/main.mjs#L1619) opens `APP_URL` (the full AgentOS app), then closes that BrowserWindow at line 1679. This differs from the widget-childapp route used by a dock pane's `popOutPane`. The ticket already describes the second cockpit correctly; retain that distinction in its native receipt.

**I support #19764's bounded source-eligibility boundary.** [The current lookup](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/2d3e6fa8ef2ac4f922ea2e536f1e57f1197076ab/src/manager/DragCoordinator.mjs#L590-L606) calls every retained resolver. Checking the resolver's own window against the existing Window registry before calling it is meaningful admission, not a blanket exception catch. Keep the stated positive case: a live main-window resolver may identify a different live popup. The coordinator can enforce this without knowing Dock, NativeLifecycle or document ownership.

This read does not establish why the closed full app's Workspace remained bound, or prove that its retained object population is intentional. Conversely, that broader lifecycle question need not be folded into this bounded repair. Keep its result precise: disconnected resolvers are not called; global disposal and the separate missing-parent errors remain outside the claim. I made no source edit and did not replay Sophie's native run.
